title: Malawi's ex-president wins election in comeback at age 85
summary: Peter Mutharika defeated the incumbent, Lazarus Chakwera, the election commission announces.

title: Danish authorities will acquire ‘enhanced capabilities’ after drones shut down Aalborg airport – Europe live
summary: Denmark’s justice and defence ministers warn that the risk of hybrid incidents is ‘here to stay’ after second drone incident in Danish airspace this week Danish defence minister says the country has not yet made a decision on whether to formally ask for Nato Article 4 talks, as Poland and Estonia did that in recent weeks. It is under consideration, defence minister Poulsen says, but confirms there’s active engagement with the EU and Nato on this. Continue reading...

title: U.S. and China Reach ‘Framework’ for a TikTok Sale
